_README: Provenance-free restatements of claims, used ONLY to build the referee's
submission. The ledger statement reaches the referee verbatim, and ours
narrate project history -- 'CORRECTION of C0009', 'the Phase 0 audit set
this as island 01's opening target', 'discharges (Z1) of byrnes_audit.md'.
That tells an adversarial reader what answer is wanted and cites documents
it cannot see, which defeats the gate.
A restatement must say the SAME mathematics as the claim, with the project
narrative removed and nothing added. It must not weaken or hedge the claim:
the referee should be able to reject the restatement exactly when it would
reject the original. These are committed so the substitution is auditable;
referee.py records in each verdict that a restatement was used, and which.
Claims absent from this file are refereed on their ledger statement, with
any leak recorded in the verdict as a noted bias.
C0012: For all integers q >= r >= 0, f(q,r) <= q + r + 1. Consequently, for each fixed r the quantity f(q,r) - q is at most r + 1 for every q >= r.
C0021: For every P-position (p,q,r) of 3-row Chomp with r >= 1, p - q <= 3r - 1. Equivalently, for each fixed r, f(q,r) - q is at most 3r - 1 for every q >= r.
